purpose: Pinned historical space-weather drivers for Phase 2E atmospheric reconstruction.

atmosphere_model.name: NRLMSIS
atmosphere_model.geomagnetic_interpretation: Storm-time mode using the full seven-element Ap history vector.

utc_boundary_control.interpretation: The modeled density change across midnight is attributable to trajectory descent through the atmospheric density gradient. The F10.7/F10.7a/Ap driver swap produced no measurable density effect at these approximately 47-km states.

interpretation_limits: These values are empirical-model forcing inputs, not spacecraft measurements.
The committed driver snapshot is used for reproducibility rather than silently consuming future updates to SW-All.csv.
